name: lead_triage
description: Triages incoming sales leads and routes them by qualification stage.
audience: Sales development reps and revenue operations

intents.name: qualified
intents.description: Lead has clear budget, authority, need, and timeline signals.

intents.name: nurture
intents.description: Interested but not ready to buy.

intents.name: unqualified
intents.description: Lead does not meet basic qualification criteria.

intents.name: spam
intents.description: Outreach that should not be processed at all (out-of-scope).

tools.name: lead_lookup
tools.purpose: Fetch existing CRM records matching a lead email or company.
when_to_use: You have an email or company name and want to check for existing records
Determining whether a lead is a duplicate of an existing account
when_not_to_use: You only have a partial name; this tool requires email or domain
You need real-time enrichment data — use enrich_company instead
tools.output_shape: dict with crm_record (or null) and any related contacts list.

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.purpose: Get firmographic data (size, industry, funding) for a company domain.
when_to_use: Determining lead qualification when CRM has no record
when_not_to_use: You already have CRM data — that is more authoritative
tools.output_shape: dict with size, industry, funding_stage, headquarters; null fields if not found.

steps: Look up CRM record via lead_lookup
If no CRM record, enrich via enrich_company
Score qualification and produce structured output

output_fields.name: next_step
output_fields.description: recommended action: AE assignment, demo schedule, etc.

steps: Identify the nurture topic from the lead text
Suggest a content sequence appropriate to the topic

output_fields.name: recommended_sequence
output_fields.description: name of the marketing sequence to enroll

output_fields.name: response_template
output_fields.description: name of the template to send

output_fields.name: crm_tag
output_fields.description: tag to apply to the record

eval_examples.description: Acme Corp asking for enterprise pricing, 200-person eval
Solo developer asking about hobby projects
PM exploring options for next quarter
